tha-ap103:1.4: vanā nibbanamāgataṁ kaṭacchubhikkhaṁ pādāsiṁ → vānā nibbānamāgataṁ kaṭacchubhikkhapādāsiṁ (sya-all) | nibbanamāgataṁ → vānā nibbānamāgataṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap103:2.3: paññāya → paññassa (bj, sya-all) | paññassa → paññāya (bj: sīmu)

tha-ap103:3.4: ādiccabandhune catunnavutito → ādiccabandhuni catunavute ito (bj) | ādiccabandhuni → vitti me pāhuṇā tāva buddhassādiccabandhuno (bj: syā, PTS, sī.selu); bandhune (bj: machasaṁ) | ādiccabandhune → vitti me pāhunā tāva, buddhassādiccabandhuno (cck: syā.)
